title: communication_constraints_violation
body: Hi After setting up two ROS machine PC1 master with realtime kernel roscore roslaunch mvp grasping robot bringup launch Listening to move group monitored planning scene PC2 client roslaunch mvp grasping wrist realsense launch Following error appear in PC1 ERROR 1580222432 680721801 libfranka Move command aborted motion aborted by reflex communication constraints violation control command success rate 0 52 Any suggestion

comments.body: This error communication constraints violation control command success rate 0 52 Happens when the network connection between the RT kernel machine and the panda is not able to transmit the control signal at 1khz as required by the panda Normally it requires a dedicated 1Gbps network connection Are you sharing network bandwidth with ROS and especially streaming camera images Depending on your networking equipment it can saturate and fail I would recommend having one network connection for ROS internet etc and a separate dedicated network link to the panda I believe this is also what is recommended by Franka This is the setup that we use and it works reliably Relevant Franka FAQ is here which has a lot of other troubleshooting tips for this error https frankaemika github io docs troubleshooting html motion stopped due to discontinuities or communication constraints violation
You are right Once I follow your instruction The error went a way

Hello The hdf5 model supplied is for the tensorflow keras implementation This version i e the version in ggcnn py is what should be running and is what is being imported by the ROS node The ggcnn torch py file is for compatibility with the updated ggcnn repository https github com dougsm ggcnn which has been ported to pytorch but I have not supplied a model for this pytorch by default uses pickled save files not hdf5 Judging by your issues it looks like the problem is that you are trying to import a keras model using pytorch ggcnn torch py I guess we should not use epoch 29 model here and that cause previous error anaconda3 envs mvp2 lib python2 7 site packages torch serialization py line 532 in load magic number pickle module load f cPickle UnpicklingError invalid load key H The hdf5 model can be imported using tensorflow 1 15 0 as per the requirements txt file and possibly other versions depending on compatibility Python 2 7 17 default Nov 27 2019 11 02 25 GCC 7 4 0 on linux2 Type help copyright credits or license for more information import tensorflow tensorflow version 1 15 0 tensorflow keras version 2 2 4 tf from tensorflow keras models import load model load model models epoch 29 model hdf5 lots of output from tensorflow tensorflow python keras engine training Model object at 0x7fd1942e6810

The model was originally trained on Cornell dataset as per Closing the loop for robotic grasping https arxiv org pdf 1804 05172 pdf The Jacquard dataset came out after this paper was published We added the Jacquard daset in the extended version of the paper https journals sagepub com doi full 10 1177 0278364919859066
